next_edition.label: La Invernal 2027, winter edition at Playa de Palomares (Cuevas del Almanzora, Almería); the organiser says Motorbeach 'cambia de escenario y de estación'; no Vinuesa 2027 date

add_sources.note: verified on page 21 Oct 2026: homepage bills 'Motorbeach 2027' as La Invernal, 26 Feb to 1 Mar 2027 in Almería, and says 'Motorbeach cambia de escenario y de estación'; no summer or Vinuesa 2027 edition mentioned.

add_gaps: Unknown whether the summer Vinuesa edition continues after 2026; the organiser has moved the 2027 edition to a winter date in Almería
verifier_flags: dates: next edition set to La Invernal 2027 (26 Feb to 1 Mar 2027, Almería), which the organiser presents as Motorbeach 2027 with a change of setting and season; the record's Vinuesa location may no longer apply
status: kept active (organiser is selling 2027 passes) but the Vinuesa event is in doubt after the 2026 fatal crash, about 435 complaints and the mayor's doubts; reputational risk for a health brand
attendance: 14,000 is a third-party sales-page figure (Sun to Sun); a 2022 report (moncloa.com) said over 7,000 and El Debate says 2026 planning assumed about 4,000; no organiser figure
notes: Special check. Search found no news on Vinuesa 2027; the organiser site is the only source for the move. IG snippet for photographers gives 28 Feb and 1 Mar 2027 for the main days.
